description: A white blob of slime sits on the desk in front of you, with a small clear plastic cup off to the right. Both hands grasp the slime as a two-hand object, stretching it outward and slightly to the right, then folding it back in; the left hand steadies and compresses while the right hand pinches and pulls up a small green piece from the slime and presses it into the top as the slime is kneaded into a flatter mound.
